Holdown Series: Notes and Footnotes (Simpson Strong-Tie Holdowns & Tension Ties - C-C-2026 & strongtie.com):
1. Allowable tension loads include the wind/seismic load duration factor C_D = 1.60; no further increase is permitted. Reduce where other load durations govern.

2. Deflection at Allowable Load (Delta_a) includes fastener slip, holdown body deformation, and anchor rod elongation within the holdown height. For shear wall deflection per SDPWS Eq. 4.3-1, total vertical elongation Delta_a = Delta_holdown * (T_ASD / T_allowable) + Delta_anchor_rod_unbonded + Delta_post_shrinkage.

3. Anchor Bolt Design: Concrete or masonry anchorage capacity (ACI 318 Chapter 17 or TMS 402) must be checked independently by the Designer. Minimum anchor bolt grade for HDU14 and HDUE17 is ASTM F1554 Grade 55 or high-strength threaded rod where required to match holdown capacity.

4. Raised Installation Above Sill Plate: HDU/HDUE holdowns may be installed up to 18 in. above the top of concrete using an anchor bolt/coupler extension provided the anchor rod is protected against buckling if subjected to compression.
